Intro: This store…I smell something good. A sweet, budding aroma. Yes…I smell DEFIANCE! ONE THAT WILL TURN TO BLOODLUST!
YOU KNOW HOW TO HAVE FUN, HUMAN! Ah, how I have missed this feeling. I have lived too long without war. FIVE YEARS EXACTLY!
I remember when I served at the bright old age of ten, and look how strong I got! Nothing beats a childhood of glory and challenge! IT IS HOW WE GROW!
I love war, human. It is in our instinct. BUT HUMANS ALWAYS LIE! WHY? Do you lie about your love, human?
Success: I LIKE YOU, HUMAN. HONEST, PROUD! I HOPE YOU THE ONE WHO WINS THE COMING WAR.
Fail: LIAR! HOW COULD YOU LIE TO ME! I HATE LIARS! I WANT TO KILL YOU! But…the *Boss* don't want that. SO UNFAIR! UNFAIR, UNFAIR, UNFAIR!
